import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianChosenTwist
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianKernelBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ModuleFiberGeneration
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianSectionRank

/-!
# Uniform evaluation and generation on arbitrary test schemes

The affine-test evaluation bound globalizes along an affine open cover of the
test scheme.  Finite support identifies the pullback of the target with the
target of the pulled-back divisor family; the canonical evaluation comparison
then identifies the two morphisms.  This supplies the evaluation epimorphism
in the campaign's D2 Grassmannian comparison over every test scheme.

The same exponent makes the canonical base-change map of the actual twisted
Cartier kernel epimorphic. Geometric generation then descends by finite-target
Nakayama to the relative kernel counit. This is Nitsure's Section 5 assertion
`(*)`, specialized to the divisor construction needed by Kleiman's `th:repDiv`
and Section 4 main theorem. Representability remains a separate obligation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Evaluation epimorphy on all affine tests implies evaluation epimorphy on
every test scheme.  The finite support of the twisted divisor is what makes
the target base-change comparison invertible. -/
theorem grassmannianEval_epi_of_affine_tests
    {S X : Scheme.{0}} {π : X ⟶ S}
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) {d : ℕ}
    (haffine : ∀ (R : CommRingCat.{0}) (f : Spec R ⟶ S)
      (y : DivFamily π (Over.mk f)),
      y.HasFiberDeg d → Epi (y.grassmannianEval L))
    {T : Over S} (x : DivFamily π T) (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d) :
    Epi (x.grassmannianEval L) := by
  apply Modules.epi_of_affine_pullbacks
  intro R g
  let ψ : Over.mk (g ≫ T.hom) ⟶ T := Over.homMk g rfl
  have hf := haffine R (g ≫ T.hom) (x.pullbackAlong ψ) (hx.pullbackAlong ψ)
  let e := pushforwardTwistPullbackIso_of_curve L hL x ψ
  have he : ((pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv ≫
        (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map (x.grassmannianEval L)) ≫ e.hom =
      (x.pullbackAlong ψ).grassmannianEval L := by
    simpa only [e, pushforwardTwistPullbackIso_of_curve_hom, Category.assoc] using
      grassmannianEval_pullback L x ψ
  have hfirst : Epi (((pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv ≫
        (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map (x.grassmannianEval L)) ≫ e.hom) :=
    he.symm ▸ hf
  have hsecond : Epi ((pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv ≫
        (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map (x.grassmannianEval L)) :=
    (epi_comp_iff_of_isIso _ e.hom).mp hfirst
  exact (epi_comp_iff_of_epi (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
    ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv _).mp hsecond

set_option maxHeartbeats 5000000 in
-- The counit traverses the kernel, two pullbacks, and their canonical comparison.
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Geometric generation of the twisted Cartier kernel descends to every
test scheme. Surjective evaluation supplies base change of kernel sections;
finite presentation of the line-bundle kernel supplies Nakayama on the total
family. This is the relative generation step of Nitsure, Section 5, assertion
`(*)`, specialized to the divisor construction used by Kleiman. -/
theorem twistQuotientKernel_counit_epi_of_geometric_tests
    {k : Type} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{0}}
    {π : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)}
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) {d : ℕ}
    (hfield : ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
      (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
      (y : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)), y.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (pullback.snd π s)).counit.app
        (kernel (y.twistQuotientMap L))))
    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (x : DivFamily π T) (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d)
    (heval : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L)) :
    Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app
      (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L))) := by
  let p := pullback.snd π T.hom
  let M := kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)
  let q := (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).counit.app M
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation :=
    (x.twistQuotientKernel_isLocallyTrivial L hL).isFinitePresentation
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have hMpush : ((Modules.pushforward p).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent p M
  have hMpull : ((Modules.pullback p).obj ((Modules.pushforward p).obj M)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom p ((Modules.pushforward p).obj M) hMpush
  refine @Modules.epi_of_geometric_field_pullbacks_of_isFinitePresentation
    (pullback π T.hom) _ M hMpull inferInstance q ?_
  intro K _ _ g
  let s := (g ≫ p) ≫ T.hom
  let ψ : Over.mk s ⟶ T := Over.homMk (g ≫ p) rfl
  haveI : Epi ((Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).map q) :=
    pullback_twistQuotientKernel_counit_epi L hL x ψ heval
      (hfield K s (x.pullbackAlong ψ) (hx.pullbackAlong ψ))
  let j : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ pullback π s :=
    pullback.lift (g ≫ pullback.fst π T.hom) (𝟙 _) (by
      simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, p, s, pullback.condition])
  have hj : j ≫ quotBaseMap π ψ = g := by
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · simp [j, Category.assoc, quotBaseMap_fst]
    · rw [Category.assoc, quotBaseMap_snd]
      change j ≫ pullback.snd π s ≫ (g ≫ p) = g ≫ p
      dsimp only [j]
      rw [pullback.lift_snd_assoc, Category.id_comp]
  let a := Modules.pullbackComp j (quotBaseMap π ψ) ≪≫ Modules.pullbackCongr hj
  haveI : Epi (((Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)) ⋙ Modules.pullback j).map q) := by
    change Epi ((Modules.pullback j).map ((Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).map q))
    infer_instance
  exact epi_of_epi_fac (a.hom.naturality q).symm

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic

attribute [local instance] Scheme.moduleKSections

/-- One tensor power gives evaluation epimorphy on every test scheme and
generates the actual twisted Cartier kernel on every geometric field test.
Its section dimension can simultaneously exceed any prescribed rank, so the
same exponent supplies the ambient Grassmannian and relative generation. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_epi_and_geometric_generation_with_rank_bound
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d r : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      r ≤ Module.finrank k
        Γ(Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
        x.HasFiberDeg d →
        Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))) ∧
      (∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
        (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))),
        x.HasFiberDeg d →
        Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app
          (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))))) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hdeg, hvan, hgen⟩ :=
    d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_with_degree_bound C d
      ((r : ℤ) + (genus C : ℤ))
  have hr : r ≤ Module.finrank k
      Γ(Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) := by
    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    obtain ⟨D, ⟨eD⟩, hD⟩ := hdeg
    have hrr := Scheme.degree_add_one_sub_genus_le_finrank_sections C
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n) D eD
    omega
  refine ⟨n, hr, ?_, hgen⟩
  have hfield : ∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ]
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
        (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))),
      x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) := by
    intro κ _ _ x hx
    refine @Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianEval_epi_of_kernel_base_hModule_one_subsingleton
      (CommRingCat.of κ) _ _ C.hom _
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))) _
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial
        (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n) x ?_
    exact hvan κ x hx
  have hspec : ∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ]
      (f : Spec (CommRingCat.of κ) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom (Over.mk f)),
      x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) := by
    intro κ _ f
    letI : Algebra k κ := (Spec.preimage f).hom.toAlgebra
    have hf : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ)) = f :=
      Spec.map_preimage f
    rw [← hf]
    exact hfield κ
  intro T x hx
  apply Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianEval_epi_of_affine_tests
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n)
    (d := d) ?_ x hx
  intro R f y hy
  exact Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianEval_epi_of_field_tests
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n)
    hspec f y hy

/-- One exponent supplies evaluation over all tests and geometric generation. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_epi_and_geometric_generation
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      (∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
        x.HasFiberDeg d →
        Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))) ∧
      (∀ (κ : Type) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
        (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ))))),
        x.HasFiberDeg d →
        Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (Scheme.baseChangeField C κ).hom).counit.app
          (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))))) := by
  obtain ⟨n, _, hn⟩ :=
    d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_epi_and_geometric_generation_with_rank_bound
      C d 0
  exact ⟨n, hn⟩

/-- For each divisor degree, one tensor power of the chosen projective twist
has epimorphic Grassmannian evaluation on every test scheme.  The exponent is
chosen before the test scheme and divisor family, over an arbitrary field
and without a rational-point hypothesis. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_epi
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
      x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) := by
  obtain ⟨n, heval, _⟩ :=
    d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_epi_and_geometric_generation C d
  exact ⟨n, heval⟩

/-- One power of the chosen twist makes both Grassmannian evaluation and
canonical base change of the actual twisted Cartier kernel epimorphic over
all test schemes.  The kernel map is the canonical comparison itself, and
the morphism between tests is arbitrary. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_and_kernel_baseChange_epi
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
      x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) ∧
        ∀ (T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (ψ : T' ⟶ T),
          Epi ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (Scheme.quotBaseSquare C.hom ψ)).app
            (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_epi C d
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro T x hx
  refine ⟨hn T x hx, ?_⟩
  intro T' ψ
  exact Scheme.DivFamily.canonicalBaseChangeMap_twistQuotientKernel_epi
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n)
    x ψ (hn T x hx)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Uniform evaluation and relative generation with a prescribed lower bound
on the actual ambient section rank. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_and_kernel_counit_epi_with_rank_bound
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d r : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      r ≤ Module.finrank k
        Γ(Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) ∧
      ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) ∧
      Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (pullback.snd C.hom T.hom)).counit.app
          (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hr, heval, hgen⟩ :=
    d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_epi_and_geometric_generation_with_rank_bound
      C d r
  have hfield : ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
      (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
      (y : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom (Over.mk s)), y.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (pullback.snd C.hom s)).counit.app
          (kernel (y.twistQuotientMap
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))) := by
    intro K _ _ s
    letI : Algebra k K := (Spec.preimage s).hom.toAlgebra
    have hs : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) = s :=
      Spec.map_preimage s
    rw [← hs]
    exact hgen K
  refine ⟨n, hr, fun T x hx => ⟨heval T x hx, ?_⟩⟩
  exact Scheme.DivFamily.twistQuotientKernel_counit_epi_of_geometric_tests
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n)
    hfield x hx (heval T x hx)

/-- For every divisor degree, one tensor power gives both Grassmannian
evaluation and relative generation of the actual twisted Cartier kernel on
every test scheme. The exponent is independent of the test and the family;
the curve is over an arbitrary field without a rational-point hypothesis. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_and_kernel_counit_epi
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) ∧
      Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (pullback.snd C.hom T.hom)).counit.app
          (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))) := by
  obtain ⟨n, _, hn⟩ :=
    d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_and_kernel_counit_epi_with_rank_bound C d 0
  exact ⟨n, hn⟩

end AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic
